text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on June 26 and 27, 2024. June 26, 2024 Councillor Morley, during the morning session of the meeting, advised Members of Council that the Toronto Public Library Board approved the renaming of the Jane/Dundas Library to the “Daniel G. Hill Library” to recognize and celebrate the significant legacy of a prominent Black Torontonian and pioneer in human rights in Ontario. Councillor Ainslie, during the morning session of the meeting, advised Members of Council that the vote on the renaming of the Jane/Dundas Library by the Toronto Public Library Board was unanimous.
